name: VPN
author: paulie420
description: Multi-provider VPN status and control for the Omarchy bar. Run several VPNs at once, each with live traffic and honest connection state. Ships PIA, WireGuard and a generic CLI provider that drives Mullvad, Proton, NordVPN, IVPN, Mozilla, Windscribe, AirVPN, FortiVPN or any NetworkManager profile from config.

barWidget.description: Connect, disconnect and monitor multiple VPNs from one panel.
